sqlMap.select: /*selectCretecProperty*/ SELECT TEXT1 AS DOMAIN, TEXT2 AS PATH, TEXT3 AS ID, TEXT4 AS PW FROM KEP.ICOMCOD2 WHERE TYPE = 'IFST' AND COMPANY_CODE = 'KRCRET0001' AND VALUE1 = #server_mode# AND FLAG = 'Y'

/*selectCretecPoList*/ SELECT DISTINCT AGENT, BUYER, PO_NO, B.TEXT3 AS CARGO, B.TEXT4 AS CARGOBIZ, REPLACE(A.ZIP_CODE,'-','') AS POSTCD, A.ADDR1 AS ADDR1, A.ADDR2 AS ADDR2, B.TEXT1 AS DELIVERYAREA, B.TEXT2 AS DELIVERYGB, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE + 1, 'YYYYMMDD')||'0700' AS DELIVERYLIST, D.COM_NAME_LOC AS DELIVERYDIRECTNM, '' AS DELIVERYDIRECTTEL, A.BUYER ||'^'|| A.PO_NO ||'^'|| A.PO_SEQ AS REMARK, A.PO_NO ||', '|| C.COM_NAME_LOC AS PO_REMARK, A.AGENT, A.BUYER, A.PO_NO, A.PO_SEQ, A.STATUS, A.REMARK AS POHD_REMARK, A.SELLER_ITEM_NO, A.ITEM_QTY, 'C' AS COMP_CD, A.DATA01 AS COM_NAME_LOC, A.DESCRIPTION, A.SPECIFICATION, A.UNIT_MEASURE, A.MAKER_NAME, B.TEXT5, B.TEXT6, A.DELY_TO_ADDRESS, A.REQ_USER_NAME, A.REQ_USER_TEL, A.AGENT_PRICE, A.AGENT_ITEM_AMT FROM EAI.IF_SUPPLY_PO_SEND A , KEP.ICOMCOD2 B , KEP.ICOMCMPY C , KEP.ICOMCMPY D WHERE A.AGENT IN ('KRCRET0001', 'KRCRET0002') AND A.IF_FLAG = 'N'
AND B.TYPE = 'C020' AND B.COMPANY_CODE = A.AGENT AND B.CODE = A.WAREHOUSE_CODE
AND C.COM_CODE = A.BUYER
AND D.COM_CODE = A.WAREHOUSE_CODE

/*selectCretecPodtList*/ SELECT A.AGENT, A.BUYER, A.PO_NO, A.PO_SEQ, A.STATUS, A.SELLER_ITEM_NO, A.ITEM_QTY, 'C' AS COMP_CD FROM EAI.IF_SUPPLY_PO_SEND A WHERE A.AGENT = #AGENT# AND A.BUYER = #BUYER# AND A.PO_NO = #PO_NO# AND A.IF_FLAG = 'N' ORDER BY A.BUYER, A.PO_NO, A.PO_SEQ
sqlMap.update:
UPDATE EAI.IF_SUPPLY_PO_SEND SET IF_FLAG = #RTN_FLAG# , IF_DATE = SYSDATE , IF_MSG = #RTN_MSG# , AGENT_PO_NO = #AGENT_PO_NO# , AGENT_PO_SEQ = #AGENT_PO_SEQ#
, DATA02 = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')
WHERE AGENT = #AGENT# AND BUYER = #BUYER# AND PO_NO = #PO_NO# AND PO_SEQ = #PO_SEQ# AND STATUS = 'C'
sqlMap.select: SELECT AGENT, BUYER, PO_NO, PO_SEQ, AGENT_PO_NO, SELLER_ITEM_NO FROM EAI.IF_SUPPLY_PO_SEND A WHERE A.AGENT = #AGENT# AND A.AGENT_PO_NO IS NOT NULL AND A.STATUS != 'D' AND A.IF_FLAG = 'S' AND NVL(A.DATA10,'PO') IN ('PO','DS') ORDER BY AGENT_PO_NO

SELECT CODE AS SELLER_ITEM_NO FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'MP-C' AND FLAG != 'N' ORDER BY CODE
sqlMap.insert: INSERT INTO EAI.AGENT_ITEM_INFO ( AGENT, SELLER_ITEM_NO, DESCRIPTION, SPECIFICATION, UNIT_MEASURE, MOQ_QTY, PUR_UNIT_QTY, PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG, STOCK_YN, MAKER_NAME, MODEL_NO, STATUS, AGENT_PRICE, SALES_PRICE ) VALUES ( 'KRCRET0001', #SELLER_ITEM_NO#, #DESCRIPTION#, #SPECIFICATION#, #UNIT_MEASURE#, #MOQ_QTY#, #PUR_UNIT_QTY#, #PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG#, #STOCK_YN#, #MAKER_NAME#, #MODEL_NO#, #STATUS#, #AGENT_PRICE#, #SALES_PRICE# )
sqlMap.select: SELECT MOQ_QTY, PUR_UNIT_QTY, PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG, STOCK_YN FROM EAI.AGENT_ITEM_INFO WHERE SELLER_ITEM_NO = #SELLER_ITEM_NO# AND AGENT = 'KRCRET0001'

SELECT A.* FROM ( SELECT COM_CODE AS BUYER, COL01_DATA AS TYPE, CASE WHEN COM_CODE = 'KRGPLK0001' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS ORD FROM KEP.BNTSLGIMP WHERE SLG_ID = 'P16-0000001' AND OPEN_DATE <= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') AND CLOSE_DATE > TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') ) A ORDER BY ORD, TYPE, BUYER
sqlMap.update: INSERT INTO EAI.AGENT_ITEM_ALERT_LIST SELECT BUYER, BUYER_ITEM_NO FROM KEP.ICOMBYIT A WHERE A.BUYER = #BUYER# AND A.STATUS IN ('C','R') AND A.PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG = 'N' AND A.BUYER_ITEM_NO IN ( SELECT BUYER_ITEM_NO FROM KEP.ICOMCQDT B, EAI.AGENT_ITEM_INFO C WHERE B.BUYER = A.BUYER AND B.AGENT = 'KRCRET0001' AND B.BUYER_ITEM_NO = A.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND B.STATUS IN ('C','R') AND B.AGENT = C.AGENT AND B.SELLER_ITEM_NO = C.SELLER_ITEM_NO AND CASE WHEN #TYPE# = 'TYPE01' AND NVL(C.STATUS,'D') IN ('E','D') AND NVL(C.STOCK_YN,'N') = 'N' THEN 1 WHEN #TYPE# = 'TYPE02' AND (NVL(C.STATUS,'D') = 'D' OR NVL(C.STOCK_YN,'N') = 'N') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END = 1 )

UPDATE KEP.ICOMBYIT A SET PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG = 'Y' , STATUS = 'R' , CHANGE_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') WHERE A.BUYER = #BUYER# AND A.STATUS IN ('C','R') AND A.PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG = 'N' AND A.BUYER_ITEM_NO IN ( SELECT BUYER_ITEM_NO FROM KEP.ICOMCQDT B, EAI.AGENT_ITEM_INFO C WHERE B.BUYER = A.BUYER AND B.AGENT = 'KRCRET0001' AND B.BUYER_ITEM_NO = A.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND B.STATUS IN ('C','R') AND B.AGENT = C.AGENT AND B.SELLER_ITEM_NO = C.SELLER_ITEM_NO AND CASE WHEN #TYPE# = 'TYPE01' AND NVL(C.STATUS,'D') IN ('E','D') AND NVL(C.STOCK_YN,'N') = 'N' THEN 1 WHEN #TYPE# = 'TYPE02' AND (NVL(C.STATUS,'D') = 'D' OR NVL(C.STOCK_YN,'N') = 'N') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END = 1 )

INSERT INTO EAI.AGENT_ITEM_ALERT_LIST SELECT BUYER, BUYER_ITEM_NO FROM KEP.ICOMBYIT A WHERE A.BUYER = #BUYER# AND A.STATUS IN ('C','R') AND A.PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG = 'Y' AND A.BUYER_ITEM_NO IN ( SELECT BUYER_ITEM_NO FROM KEP.ICOMCQDT B, EAI.AGENT_ITEM_INFO C WHERE B.BUYER = A.BUYER AND B.AGENT = 'KRCRET0001' AND B.BUYER_ITEM_NO = A.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND B.STATUS IN ('C','R') AND B.AGENT = C.AGENT AND B.SELLER_ITEM_NO = C.SELLER_ITEM_NO AND CASE WHEN #TYPE# = 'TYPE01' AND C.STATUS = 'Y' OR (C.STATUS = 'E' AND C.STOCK_YN = 'Y') THEN 1 WHEN #TYPE# = 'TYPE02' AND (C.STATUS != 'D' AND C.STOCK_YN = 'Y') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END = 1 )

UPDATE KEP.ICOMBYIT A SET PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG = 'N' , STATUS = 'R' , CHANGE_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') WHERE A.BUYER = #BUYER# AND A.STATUS IN ('C','R') AND A.PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG = 'Y' AND A.BUYER_ITEM_NO IN ( SELECT BUYER_ITEM_NO FROM KEP.ICOMCQDT B, EAI.AGENT_ITEM_INFO C WHERE B.BUYER = A.BUYER AND B.AGENT = 'KRCRET0001' AND B.BUYER_ITEM_NO = A.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND B.STATUS IN ('C','R') AND B.AGENT = C.AGENT AND B.SELLER_ITEM_NO = C.SELLER_ITEM_NO AND CASE WHEN #TYPE# = 'TYPE01' AND C.STATUS = 'Y' OR (C.STATUS = 'E' AND C.STOCK_YN = 'Y') THEN 1 WHEN #TYPE# = 'TYPE02' AND (C.STATUS != 'D' AND C.STOCK_YN = 'Y') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END = 1 )

UPDATE ICOMCOD1 A SET (TEXT1, TEXT2, FLAG, ADD_DATE) = (SELECT PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG, STOCK_YN, 'T', TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') FROM EAI.AGENT_ITEM_INFO WHERE AGENT = 'KRCRET0001' AND SELLER_ITEM_NO = A.CODE ) WHERE TYPE = 'MP-C' AND FLAG != 'N' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 'X' FROM EAI.AGENT_ITEM_INFO WHERE AGENT = 'KRCRET0001' AND SELLER_ITEM_NO = A.CODE AND PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG = A.TEXT1 AND STOCK_YN = A.TEXT2 )
